When he is presumed dead after a severe accident, a promised settlement sparks a bitter feud between his wives and their families, each scheming for control of the money. Just as the battle turns vicious, Murugesan returns alive, only to become a burden to those who once mourned him. Faced with betrayal and greed, Murugesan and his disillusioned sons walk away, leaving behind a biting satire on family, loyalty, and the corrupting power of money.

title: The secret of the oleaster tree
overview: An old man and an old woman had a disagreement at their wedding feast many years ago and called it off. They still hold a grudge against each other to this day...

title: Kadha
overview: After a long wait, Madhava and Sethulekshmi are blessed with a male child, Nandu. They want him to become a doctor, but problems arise when he has other plans after growing up.

title: Kambolam
overview: Gounder, a tyrannical landlord, rules his village according to his whims and fancies. Thommichan and his family members decide to put an end to it and take over the village market from Gounder.

title: Oraon
overview: In 1957, Ghatak premiered Oraon. This is often regarded as a preparatory work for Ajantrik and is based on the Oraon tribes. It was shot in 1955 in Chhota Nagpur. Incidentally, some footage from Oraon was also used in Ajantrik.

title: Dravidan
overview: Podiparavakkan, a businessman's henchman, terrorises the village of Palakkara. When he gets killed, his son Rarichan returns to the village but the villagers do not allow him to live peacefully.

title: Thumbolarcha
overview: Thumbolarcha is a legendary female warrior from the North Kerala Vadakkanpattu ballads, known for her strength and beauty, who was also the sister of Unniyarcha. Her story often involves a conflict with Chandu, who desires her and also has a relationship with her family.

title: Surya
overview: The story of Surya, a middle-class youngster struggling to find a decent job but to his misfortune, he never achieves any success at the task

title: Puruliar Chhau
overview: In 1970, Ghatak explored the traditional heritage of Chhau in the documentary titled Puruliar Chhau. He explores the life of the performers, including close shots of eminent dancers like Madhu Ray, Gokul Roy, Gambhir Singh and Lal Mahato. His use of flambeau (a rural life lighting to avoid technical lights) and the dramatic way of the narration in which the narrator becomes an integral part of Chhau are highpoints of this documentary. Ritwik went to showcase how tribals use this artform to articulate their struggle against oppression and exploitation in this documentary as well as in Jukti Takko Aar Gappo.

title: Kalari Kid – She Hits Back
overview: In a society marked by gendered violence, nine-year-old Arushi and Milena, twenty-one, reclaim space through Kalari—the world’s oldest martial art. The film follows their fight for self-empowerment and the freedom to be the women they chose to be.

title: Richard II
overview: A historical chronicle covering the events of 1399–1400; at its center is the deposition of King Richard II and the seizure of power by his cousin Henry Bolingbroke — the founder of the House of Lancaster, Henry IV — followed by the murder of the captive Richard.

title: Asambhav
overview: Mansi, an architect haunted by nightmares of a brutal murder in a mysterious haveli, falls in love with industrialist Aditya Deshmukh as they collaborate for a prestigious project in Nainital. When she discovers the haveli from her dreams is real, dark secrets from the past threaten to destroy their present, forcing her to choose between love and a terrifying truth.

title: Matir Phul
overview: Matir Phool is a romantic film starring of Riaz and Shabnur

title: King of My Love
overview: The noble and beloved policeman Ramash, thanks to whom peace and order reign in the city of Khurmada, joins the fight against the cunning, greedy bandit Shamar. Shamar, raised by foster parents, arranges a series of crimes in the city, and Ramash stands up for Khurmada. During the active confrontation, it turns out that Ramash and Shamar are brothers separated in childhood. The brothers' investigation leads them to the trail of the culprit of the great fire that claimed the lives of Ramash and Shamar's parents. They turn out to be Khurmada's main patron and patron, Sandurlai, with whom they have to fight.

title: The Gin Game
overview: The action of the play takes place in the USA, in a nursing home. In Bentley House, or the 'house of death,' as it is called by the people, fate brings together a wealthy businessman and a female manager. Each has their own life, their own drama behind them. Family, children, home, work, successes – all in the past. Everything starts quite decently. He suggests they have some fun – play cards, teaching her the card game gin, while cynically discussing his surroundings, calling it 'a dump of bodies not quite ready for the cemetery.' The lady proves to be a quick learner and unexpectedly wins. He, torn between two conflicting feelings (sympathy for this woman and the passion of a gambler), and she, seeking a cure for her loneliness in their meetings. Both need communication with each other, but for him, the main goal becomes winning at cards against this woman. And perhaps, winning against life itself...

title: Detective Brothers
overview: Operating a fidelity testing agency in Istanbul, a small team takes on a job to document a British diplomat's affair. However, what begins as a routine surveillance operation quickly plunges them into the crosshairs of an international intelligence conspiracy.

title: Water of repentance
overview: The people of Yazd are harassed by Qasim the extortionist, until Habib and Tahir force Qasim to change his ways. One night, Habib meets Shirin, Qasim's friend, in a notorious neighborhood and offers to marry her if she repents. Habib takes Shirin to Mashhad and gives his sister Maryam to Tahir. Qasim, who holds a grudge against Tahir, insults Maryam. The local baker, who witnesses the incident, remains silent, and Tahir marries Maryam to protect his reputation and that of his friend. Qasim's henchmen spread the rumor that Tahir married her after deceiving Maryam. They lock him in a room to silence the baker. Habib returns to Yazd with the intention of taking revenge; But the local confidants force him and Taher to face each other in the depths of the fort to prevent bloodshed. Before the fight begins, the baker escapes with a wounded body and, with Shirin's help, makes his way to the fort and reveals the truth. Habib and Taher go after Qasim and eventually hand him over to the police.

title: Confederate
overview: Reza and Munir promise to be faithful to each other forever. Meanwhile, Akbar, who is Reza's close friend, returns from his trip. Akbar falls in love with Monir at first sight and asks Reza to propose to her. Reza, although she has arranged her marriage with Munir, asks her to marry Akbar. Munir, for Reza's sake, accepts the proposal.

title: The Laughter of the Lobster
overview: The play tells the story of the last year of the life of the legendary French actress Sarah Bernhardt. Sarah's life is coming to an end. She must hurry to tell the truth about herself, so she writes her memoirs.

title: Mustafa Lor
overview: When Mustafa Lera is released from prison, he searches for a friend named Abdullah, who is supposed to provide him with information about the killers of his sister's husband, but he finds him dead. Mustafa Lera eventually finds the two killers and kills them, then returns to prison himself.

title: After the Fall
overview: The play is dedicated to the unsuccessful marriage of Arthur Miller and Marilyn Monroe.

title: The Foreigner Mehdi
overview: Mehdi (Mohammad Reza Fazeli), a taxi driver, lives with her son Afshin (Afshin Zolfaghari) and Abbas (Mansour Sepehrnia), her husband's brother, after the death of his wife...

title: Dedication to Eve
overview: Extraordinary and mysterious events begin very ordinarily: journalist Larsen arrives at the home of the famous writer, Nobel laureate Znorco, to conduct an interview. The writer lives alone on an island in the Norwegian Sea. During the interview, details of Znorco’s life and work are revealed. The writer's new novel is a genuine correspondence between Znorco and his lover, who later became Larsen's wife. Several years ago, she passed away, yet letters from her continued to arrive.

title: Stepmother
overview: Niloufar and Bahram, who are in love with each other, get married, and Niloufar, who has great wealth, brings everyone under Bahram's will..

title: Sunny Night
overview: When Nusrat is released from prison after four years, his fiancée, Leila, whom Suleiman has disfigured, marries Suleiman. Qavam, Nusrat's old friend, returns from a trip and arranges with Nusrat to kill Suleiman when Nusrat has a witness to prove his innocence, and in return, Nusrat will kill his uncle Nasir, who has taken over his father's wealth and intends to marry his mother. Qavam informs Nusrat after a fight with Suleiman...

title: The White Clove
overview: Setareh (Forozan) is the singer of a cheerleading group. Mahmoud (Abdullah Butimar), who has become Setareh's admirer, provides her and her friends with a luxurious house and invites them to perform at a large nightclub. A young student named Masoud (Taqi Mokhtar) expresses his interest in Setareh, despite her parents' opposition. Setareh, who is suffering from cancer, refuses to attend the nightclub at Masoud's request, until Masoud's father calls Setareh and asks her to cut off contact with him for the sake of Masoud and his fiancée, and Setareh agrees. Setareh's condition worsens and her friends struggle to pay for her treatment. Masoud learns of his father's meeting with Setareh on his wedding day and goes to apologize. Setareh dies in Masoud's arms.

title: The Beautiful Sin
overview: A greedy man sends his wife to prison on the pretext of debt in order to obtain the woman he desires. The woman, who is in financial difficulty, turns to the greedy man, but resists his demands and is severely injured. The greedy man, thinking that he has murdered the woman, abandons her in the desert and escapes. The wife is released from prison with the help of her friends. Based on the evidence, she initially becomes suspicious of her husband, but soon the truth is revealed and the greedy man is caught in the law. The wife and her husband also start a new life.

title: Military
overview: Madhavan is known as Military due to his strict attitude towards his five sisters. However, when he is forced to get his first sister married to a widowed professor, his other sisters alienate him.

title: Crossing the Night
overview: Farhad (Vafa) and Marguerite (Shahrzad Armani) have been interested in each other since their school years, but one is muslim and the other one is christian...

title: Style
overview: Style stars Raghava Lawrence, Gayathri Raghuram and Vadivelu

title: Poor Fellow
overview: "Nemat" is a simple shepherd who marries a girl named "Satare". Setare is the target of a smuggler named "Jasem". Nemat gets into a fight with him over Setare and ends up in prison with Jasem's shoes. In Nemat's absence, Setare, out of fear of Jasem, goes to the desert with "Tuba" (Nemat's sister who was raped by Jasem). When Nemat returns, when Jasem spreads rumors against Setare, Touba, who hates Jasem deeply, kills him in a fight and goes to prison herself. Nemat and Setare also start a simple life.

title: Stranger
overview: Maziar (Iraj Ghaderi) and Parviz (Bahman Mofid) are two half-brothers who have grown up under the care of Afkham al-Dowleh (Iran Ghaderi). Maziar is engaged to Maryam (Puri Benai); but an earthquake strikes Qazvin, the girl's hometown, and she is displaced.

title: Thursday Night
overview: Her final university party ended in a twelve-hour blackout. Waking up in her room with a terrifying blank, Mithila is convinced something horrific occurred—and now, trapped by her own fractured memory, she trusts absolutely no one.

title: Fatemeh with the Boots
overview: Fatemeh (Yasmin Sadri) runs away from her father's (Hossein Amirfazli) house and is met by a young driver named Nader Siah (Homayun Bahadran). Nader takes her to the house of her mother (Malihe Nasiri) and her brother (Amir). Nader's mother informs Fitne's father and returns the girl to her father's house. A man named Shoja (Mansour Matin) and a driver named Ismail (Mohammad Eskandari) insult Fitne and her friend Mojgan (Marguerite). Fitne keeps the matter a secret from Nader. Fearing disgrace, she marries a young man named Ali (Manouchehr Valizadeh) at Mojgan's suggestion. Parvaneh (Jaleh) decides to kill Fitne; but Ismail prevents her. Ali divorces her to save Fitne's life. When Fitneh decides to start a new life with Nader, Shoja, who has no children, tries to take over Fitneh's son. Shoja and several others go to Nader's house and after a struggle, they kidnap the child. While fleeing, Shoja crashes into a car and dies.

title: An Aristocrat Beggar
overview: Zohra is a poor girl who meets Masoud; but Masoud's father, Ashraf, who is a wealthy man, opposes their marriage. Zohra pretends to be an orphan; but Jahangir reveals that Ismat, Zohra's famous mother, is alive.

title: Sacrifice myself for all the beauties
overview: Setwar Khan Nayeb (Abdul Ali Homayoun) plans to marry his niece Maryam (Parastu) to his son Bahram (Arif); but Bahram is in love with Parvin (Marjan).

title: The Controversy
overview: Tahir and his student Jamal are truck drivers. Tahir is in love with Goli, who works at Karim's coffee shop. Tahir and Goli get married, making Karim jealous and...

title: Yavar
overview: Yavar (Reza Beyk Imanvardi), a truck driver, saves Maryam (Arzoo Ghaffari) who has fallen into a well, and meets her brother, Karim (Hossein Gil). Yavar and his student Ali (Mehdi Fakhimzadeh) take Karim to their hometown of Shiraz. Karim accidentally kills a passerby, and Yavar introduces himself to the police instead of Karim. While Yavar is in prison, Karim insults Yavar's sister, Nosrat (Aram), and at the same moment, Qoli Palang (Ahmad Moeini) rapes his own sister. Karim flees to Tehran and, after learning what happened to Maryam, decides to kill her; but his mother stops him. In Tehran, Nosrat meets a singer (Nadia) and takes refuge in her house. Some time later, Yavar is released and looks for Karim. Karim escapes from him and Ali and gets into a fight with a leopard in a ruin outside the city. Eventually, both are injured, and Karim expresses remorse in Yavar's arms before dying. Ali asks Yavar for permission to marry Nusrat.

title: Friday
overview: Four men: Akbar, a taxi driver, Mansour, a government employee, Mustafa, a boxer, and Qasem, a smuggler, return a man's stolen wallet, and the man issues a check for forty thousand tomans in their names as a reward. The next day is a holiday, and they, who do not trust each other, move into Mansour's house. Mansour lives with his wife and daughter Marzieh, and Mustafa falls in love with the girl, who has already been deceived. Mustafa defeats his opponent in the Asian qualifying match, which is held on Friday. In the meantime, Qasem arranges with his friends to be ready on Saturday when the check is collected and to steal the wallet. Qasem's accomplices intervene, and Mansour is killed in a fight with Qasem's bullets. Qasem is arrested, and Mansour, at the last moment, hands his daughter over to Mustafa.

title: Bhalobasar Rong
overview: A beautiful story of love and passion.

title: Fabrications
overview: This Super 8 short film was discovered on May 22, 2024, at the Paraguayan-German Cultural Institute in Asunción. The film is the result of a workshop produced by the ICPA's film department in 1987, led by filmmaker Marie Louise Alemann, a pioneer of experimental cinema in Argentina.

title: Tadji
overview: In a bustling Iranian factory, the rhythms of daily labor intertwine with the quiet struggles of its workers. Among them is Tadji, a woman navigating the weight of personal and professional challenges alongside her husband, Morteza. When a sudden disruption unsettles the workplace, tensions rise and hidden truths begin to surface. Tadji explores themes of trust, resilience, and the fragile balance between duty and desire, offering a poignant reflection on the choices that shape human relationships.

title: Reflextion
overview: A woman returns, after a long time, to an empty house to confront her memories.

title: BP 180
overview: Thangam is an honest doctor working at Pennery Hospital. He has a sister named Selvi and a brother named Stalin. Arnold, a villain from Kasimedu area,Through this, Thangams brother Stalin is killed. The story revolves around whether Thangam did a postmortem on Bharathis body.

title: One Beautiful and 1000 Problems
overview: A wise man's job is to find young men with good lineage but no financial means, and after training them in various skills with masters, he introduces them to wealthy families with daughters, and after they are able to get married, he makes money in this way...

title: The word of truth
overview: After twenty-five years in prison, Sarallah tries to avoid evil and theft, but in practice he cannot and steals again. One night, while fleeing (from the police pursuit), he enters the house of a cleric. The cleric's words captivate him and he leads an honorable life. Meeting a woman named Badri makes him determined to start a family and get married, but at this time, Badri's ex-wife arrives. Having a long-standing grudge against Badri, she accuses Badri of a serious crime and sends him to prison. Nasrallah is responsible for raising Badri's daughter, Maryam. Twenty years later, Badri sees his daughter Maryam again. At this time, Nasrallah is a staunch and honorable old man.

title: Godspeed
overview: Mehri and Keyvan spend their holidays in Bandar with their parents. Mehri falls in love with a young man named Hemet, and Keyvan falls in love with Hemet's sister (Zinet). Despite their parents' approval, the two couples decide to get married. Zeinet and Keyvan get married, and Hemet goes to Tehran to buy a wedding dress. But he loses his money and, since he has no intention of returning, he stays in Tehran. Zeinet is unloved by her family, and when she gives birth to her child (the child is black), Keyvan drives her away on the pretext of infidelity. The family doctor shelters Zeinet, and Mehri commits suicide in order to blame her parents, but a series of incidents and actions taken by the doctor resolve the problem and the two couples live a peaceful life.

title: Punishment
overview: Malook (Criminal Angel), the daughter of the local hero (Valiullah Shirandam), runs away from her father's house to fulfill her dreams and joins a group of vagrants who call themselves "hippies"...

title: The Restless Man
overview: Reza proposes marriage to Fatemeh...

title: The Man of Night
overview: Bram Chakhan (Saeed Rad), who was in a car accident during his teenage years that caused the death of his friend Bijan, is tormented by a guilty conscience...

title: Spa
overview: The narrative follows the intertwined lives of people connected to La Paradise, an urban massage therapy centre. It centres on Mathan, a man struggling to distinguish between the reality of love and its fictionalised ideals. Through a sharp lens of social satire, the story explores adult themes and human behaviour within this unique urban setting.

title: Breathtaking
overview: Sadegh is a former smuggler and lives with his wife Parvaneh. But when new police Ahmad Pejman comes to live there destiny has other plans for Sadegh.

title: Swallows in Love
overview: Abbas and his brother Jamal live next door to Haj Mustafa, who has a young daughter named Leila..

title: Navab
overview: In an accident Navvab saves the life of an unknown girl and falls in love with her. He goes around looking for her. In the meanwhile his mom asks him to marry a girl she knows. Unaware that the suggested girl is the one he is after, Navvab asks his close friend Habib to marry the girl.

title: Furry
overview: Iranian comedy about a talking dog

title: The Only Supporter
overview: Karim introduces Abi to a girl named Nasrin, who takes care of his blind son Saeed and sings in Abbas's cafe. Karim warns Abi against continuing his relationship with Nasrin, and upon meeting Nasrin, he realizes that she is the woman he abandoned in Bandar years ago and that Saeed is his own son. The two reconcile, and Abi suspects that Karim has betrayed him. On Abbas's advice, Abi drags Karim to a secluded house to take revenge on him; but Nasrin explains to Abi the story of her and Karim's long-standing love. Abi enters the fray and is stabbed by Abbas.

title: Accusation
overview: Sadeq (Bahman Mofid) and Hojjat (Manouchehr Vosouq) are two cousins.

title: Turkmen
overview: In the Turkmen desert region, Artaq (Nasser Malek Motiei) sends his mother several times to propose to Qalich Khan's daughter; but the girl's father does not consent. Artaq kidnaps the girl from the riverbank and takes her to a shrine. Qalich and his sons forgive her. At night, Farid (Iraj Qaderi) and his friend (Rafi Madadkar) enter the shrine to steal the holy tablet. The thieves leave Farid behind and his people capture and imprison Artaq. The two escape and after a chase and escape, they reach Ebad, the main thief.

title: Pure
overview: Naser and Ghulam, who have been released from prison, have been living off theft. Nasser searches for Maryam (Hala Nazari) to get back the son he entrusted to him, but in the meantime, he falls in love with Maryam and marries her.

title: The Cry of Love
overview: Ali a port worker, and Hossam, a head worker, propose to Goli, the daughter of Mesh Mohammad. Morteza, Hossam's nephew, who pretends to be friends with Ali, is also interested in Goli. Goli marries Ali away from her father's eyes, and Ali, according to a plan devised by Hossam and Morteza, engages in smuggling to earn a living and is pursued by the gendarmes. Ali escapes to Tehran and Goli follows him; but he cannot find him. Some time later, Ali returns to his hometown and proves his innocence, and at Mesh Mohammad's request, he goes to Tehran to find his wife. Ali's efforts are in vain. In a short time, he becomes the owner of a large company through hard work and diligence, and Goli, who has set up a tailoring shop, raises her daughter Zari with the help of a local prostitute named Jalal. Jalal is interested in Goli; But he doesn't say anything until Ali comes across Zari and falls in love with her. Jalal, who is aware of the situation, opposes,

title: Incredible Movement
overview: Schoolboy Vanya Fyodorov skips class to take advantage of his parents' absence to test a universal homework computer program he invented. But due to a glitch in the program, instead of the expected paper, Vanya receives three guests from the past, one of whom is none other than Philippus Aureolus Theophrastus Bombastus von Hohenheim, later known as Doctor of Medicine Paracelsus. Vanya and his sister Lisa must, at all costs, return Paracelsus to his former self.…

title: The Condemned
overview: Asgar and Qader have been friends since childhood. Hussein General, a man of bad character who leads the local teenagers in a fight with the teenagers of Qala Sangi neighborhood, has dedicated his life to their happiness. Asgar and Qader both loved Zainab; but Zainab is married to Asgar. Asgar, who is suspicious of his wife's affairs, constantly annoys Hussein General and Qader. One day, while picking date clusters from a palm tree, while thinking about his wife's relationship with Qader, he falls from the top of the palm tree and loses his sight. Zainab and Qader take care of him; but Asgar's sense of pessimism and suspicion towards his wife and Qader increases. Asgar drags Qader to the palm grove and while he is praying, he cuts him to pieces with a turban and throws his body into the sea. General Hussein, who witnesses the incident, informs Zeinab; but he, unable to allay his wife's insane suspicion, kindly invites the local waterman to his house for lunch.

title: Corruptors
overview: A man and a woman, including a high-ranking army officer, a prostitute, a fake doctor, and a drug smuggler who were active against the people before the revolution, lure the captain of the barge to let them cross the water border. A young worker is also with the passengers who are going to find work in Arab countries. Along the way, he becomes interested in the officer's daughter. The captain of the barge disembarks them on a deserted island. As the water rises, they find themselves facing death, and with great effort, they return to the barge and confront the captain and the workers. When a group of people from both sides starts to fight, they lose their lives. The officer's daughter and the young worker are the only people who survive this group. After a while, the two meet in a boat and, seeing the tricolor flag of Iran from afar, they realize that they are returning to their country.

title: Soldier of Islam
overview: A Muslim fighter is injured in a clash with security officers. His sister rescues him from the officers and he takes refuge in a house frequented by the son of a high-ranking SAVAK official, who is not a Muslim. The young man falls in love with the girl, but her father, a SAVAK officer, who is against their marriage, creates trouble for the fighter's siblings. As a result of the sibling clashes, the boy is influenced by the sibling's actions and converts to Islam and marries the girl. A short time later, he and the girl's brother are killed in a clash with security officers.

title: Smart Sunbai
overview: The film carries a strong element of suspense, and through the clash between urban and rural female characters, it delivers both chaos and entertainment.

title: Dandelion
overview: Ghasem is a young gambler who makes a living by stealing old women's purses. His mother treats him kindly. But his father, a police officer, ignores him. His father throws him out of the house and Qasim moves in with his friend Aziz. Qasim steals Zari's purse, and a few days later, Zari, upon seeing Qasim, chases him and faints in a car accident. Qasim takes her to a friend's house, and Zari, after regaining consciousness, starts a brawl. The two gradually become interested in each other. Qasim steals the guests' purses at a party at her house, and Zari's stepmother sees him. Zari leaves her stepmother's house and takes refuge with Qasim, and Qasim marries her. Qasim, unable to find a decent job, robs a jewelry store after discovering that Zari is pregnant and is killed by a bullet fired by his father while trying to escape.

title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

title: Chlahbia
overview: In a rapidly growing Moroccan city, an influential group of politicians and powerful businessmen orchestrates a Machiavellian plan: they manipulate Nabil, a petty pickpocket, into becoming a supposed political activist. They propel him to the head of the town hall with a simple objective: to use his position to serve their interests by swindling the city's inhabitants.

title: Dimlight
overview: Tears hidden behind laughter, a quiet love tucked between family quarrels, and the struggle of a comedian trying to survive a life that is anything but humorous. In a joyless household, and enchanted by an unfamiliar woman, Shamsuzzaman finds himself lost as a duel between comedy and crisis begins in his life.

title: Telegram - The Dark Empire by Pavel Durov
overview: Last bastion of freedom of expression or playground for extremists and criminals? Opinions are divided on the messaging service Telegram. Just like on its mysterious founder, tech billionaire Pavel Durov. Is this man an uncompromising advocate of radical freedom or an accomplice of criminals of all kinds? Author Aleksandr Urzhanov searches for answers.

title: Gamecock
overview: A woman's husband experiences misfortunes due to his neglect of his wife and children.

title: The World of Money
overview: Ahmad leaves his father SafarAli and his mother, so he can go to Tehran and work there.

title: Morad and Laleh
overview: A little brother and sister lose their parents in an accident. Then the brother and sister lose each other. A wealthy family adopts the girl, and the boy meets an old wanderer. The old man sees the girl and takes her brother to her, but the girl is about to travel with her adoptive parents. The old man and the boy go to the airport, and at the last moment, the sister and brother find each other. From then on, they both live together in the wealthy man's family.

title: The Ten-Million-Toman man
overview: Ahmad and Mamali lose their jobs after fighting with their taxi owners.

title: Three Private Detectives
overview: Amir, Mansour, and Nader get interested in private detective work after watching crime TV shows.

title: Sea Guards
overview: Javad and Mansour join the navy and become interested in the petty officer's daughters.

title: Blood Money
overview: Ahmad and Samad, along with their mother and little brother, are going from their village to the city and staying at their older brother Ebrahim's house.

title: Charlatan
overview: Years ago, Bahram lost his wife, Nasrin, during childbirth and now lives with his daughter, Nasrin, and his mother, Zahra.

title: Escapism
overview: A middle-aged doctor and his young assistant are both smitten with a girl. The girl likes the doctor's assistant, but the doctor, who is deeply in love with the girl, sends the assistant away on some pretext. He then gets closer to the girl and, with the support of her parents, marries her. They have a peaceful life until the assistant returns and the truth comes out. After a series of events, it's ultimately the doctor who steps aside.

title: Hell Drivers
overview: Reza, a young truck driver at a truck stop, falls for a girl. His brother, a teacher in the literacy corps, also becomes smitten with her. Unaware of Reza's feelings, the teacher asks his brother to propose to the girl on his behalf. Reza agrees, but a wicked and lustful man who also desires the girl pits the two brothers against each other. He sabotages the truck stop in an attempt to eliminate them. Reza thwarts the lustful man's plan, but the younger brother is killed by him. Eventually, Reza captures the killer, and the police arrest him.

title: Double Agent
overview: Iraj, a key member of a criminal gang, gets shot during a robbery. The police, aware of Iraj's twin brother, prepare him and infiltrate him into the gang. They then meticulously monitor all details and eventually apprehend the criminals.

title: Runaway Groom
overview: A father on his deathbed stipulates that after his death, his two children will inherit his property on the condition that his grandchildren marry each other and have children.
